summary: Brookfield Infrastructure Partners L.P. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a bought-deal offering of 4,000,000 5.75% Cumulative Minimum Rate Reset Class A Preferred Limited Partnership Units, Series 19, at C$25.00 per unit for gross proceeds of C$100 million. The units are issued by subsidiary Brookfield Infrastructure L.P., guaranteed by BIP and BIPC Holdings Inc. A syndicate led by Scotiabank, BMO, CIBC, National Bank, RBC and TD has a 48-hour option for 2,000,000 additional units, potentially C$150 million. This is a routine preferred equity shelf takedown, not a special situation.
